vectors.name: Testnet-only top-up
vectors.expect: card.funded is completed only with a finalized YNX Testnet transaction hash and authoritative receipt

vectors.name: Card payment data redaction
vectors.expect: PAN, CVV, track, PIN, cryptogram, and magnetic-stripe fields are rejected because additional properties are false

vectors.name: Immutable balanced journal
vectors.expect: each card event references a durable-ledger candidate journal entry; corrections are new reversal entries and reconciliation stays explicit

vectors.name: No wallet gate
vectors.expect: card simulation events are asynchronous observations and cannot change wallet connection or approval behavior
